positions.title: Senior Autonomy Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design, implement, and debug autonomy software for mining and industrial vehicles, primarily in C++. Work across engineering teams to resolve complex system issues and support vehicle integration, validation, and software releases.

• Core Technologies: C++, Python, Bash, Linux, RTI Connext DDS, Protobuf
• Software Architecture & Concurrency: Distributed Systems, State Machines, Interface Design, C++ Multithreading & Synchronization
• Communications & Vehicle Integration: V2V/V2I, Wi-Fi Mesh, CAN, Radar, GNSS, PTP
• Cross-team Collaboration: Contribute to architecture decisions, clarify technical requirements, and assess integration risks and release readiness.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Linux · Software Architecture · DDS · System Integration

positions.title: Senior Software Research Engineer (과장/선임연구원)
positions.description:
• Leading Multitasking Framework for Android Phone
  - Improve performance and develop Multitasking Framework (QSlide1) as a function leader
  - Contributed model: All LG mobile phone released in 2013~2014 including G2, G3, G4, G-Flex-I/II, G-Pad
• Leading View System Framework for Android Phone
  - Develop and applied Google Android View System Framework to commercial products
  - Contributed model: G2, G3, G4
• Mobile 3D Camera/Player instructor 
  - Related Model: Optimus 3D
  - Targeted foreign local Service center engineers (on/off-line)
• Junior Board2 in company (2013~2014)
• Retention Bonus recipient in 2013
  - Specified as an outstanding research engineer

positions.title: Junior Software Research Engineer (대리/주임연구원)
positions.description:
• Multimedia Framework for Google Android Phone
  - Performance improvement for video player codec/parser framework
  - Developing Camera/Camcorder Framework 
  - Developing dual 3D camera/camcorder Framework
  - Developing glasses-free 3D player Framework
  - Co-worked with Qualcomm, Texas Instrument, and many multimedia solutions companies
  - Business Trip: U.S.A (2 months), India (2 weeks), Bulgaria (1 month)
  - Contributed model: Andro-one (LG’s first Android phone), Optimus 3D (Dual camera & glasses-free 3D phone), Prada-II
• Linux Server administrator (2008~2012)
